restaurant_name: ขนาบน้ำ คลินิกเทคนิคการแพทย์
text:
Staff is very friendly, helpful & professional. Quick 6-in-1 nasal swab testing (฿450): lab technician (Hashimi) skilled to properly collect specimen without entirely compromising patient comfort. As a medical professional, I am thoroughly impressed!

Afterward, I took lab results next door to clinic for Dr. to issue Medical Certificate.
The 2nd clinic is where waiting may be required.
